en: The postcard depicts a vintage scene of people disembarking from small boats in front of a large steamboat on calm waters. The setting appears to be near a coast, with well-dressed passengers, likely from the early 20th century. There is printed and handwritten text in French and Greek, with a green postage stamp in the upper right corner. The words 'LOUTRAKI' and 'Débarquement à Loutraki' are clearly visible, along with their Greek translation.
